execution_rules: Update the plan before each practical step with bottleneck, theory, hard bound, commands, and rejection criteria.
Run fixed-text top1/correctness before token-rate benchmark for any path that can affect logits.
Record token rate, prompt rate, TTFT, elapsed time, RAM/page-cache counters, answer, command/env, source head, binary hashes, run path, and artifact hash.
Immediately commit and push any accepted new SOTA to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb, then reproduce from pushed source.
Revert rejected runtime source, rebuild the accepted path, and commit/push only rejected artifacts/docs.
